# gravitino_liveness Data Source



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_liveness" "status" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `checks` (Block List) Liveness check details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--checks))
- `status` (String) The liveness status.

<a id="nestedblock--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `checks`

Read-Only:

- `details` (Map of String) Additional details for the liveness check.
- `name` (String) Name of the liveness check.
